reviews.review_description:
the only thing you can do is move around a bit. 

Also venus seems to orbit the sun in the wrong direction, i know it spins the backwards, but it should definitely orbit the same direction as earth.

Seeing the solar system move around our sun is sort of awe inspiring but the controllers do nothing.
You can't interact with anything or zoom the planets towards you to see them fully.
As new as this app is, I will give it a fair rating but it could be better and interactive.
